def process(water_2020, water_2021, water_2022, water_2023) -> pd.DataFrame:
    dfs = [water_2020, water_2021, water_2022, water_2023]
    combined = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    
    # Filter for freshwater beaches only
    fresh = combined[combined['Beach Type Description'] == 'Fresh'].copy()
    
    # Normalize Violation column (handle both 'Yes'/'No' and 'YES'/'NO')
    fresh['Violation'] = fresh['Violation'].str.upper()
    fresh['Sample Date'] = pd.to_datetime(fresh['Sample Date'])
    fresh['Year'] = fresh['Year'].astype(int)
    fresh['Month'] = fresh['Sample Date'].dt.month
    
    # Calculate monthly exceedance rate (violation rate) by year and month
    monthly_rate = fresh.groupby(['Year', 'Month']).apply(
        lambda x: (x['Violation'] == 'YES').sum() / len(x)
    ).reset_index()
    monthly_rate.columns = ['Year', 'Month', 'Exceedance_Rate']
    
    return monthly_rate

def process(trend_analysis) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = trend_analysis.copy()
    
    # Calculate month-to-month changes for both metrics
    df['exceedance_change'] = df['Exceedance_Rate'].diff()
    df['rainfall_change'] = df['Rainfall'].diff()
    
    # Determine direction of change (1 for increase, -1 for decrease, 0 for no change/equal)
    df['exceedance_direction'] = df['exceedance_change'].apply(lambda x: 1 if x > 0 else (-1 if x < 0 else 0))
    df['rainfall_direction'] = df['rainfall_change'].apply(lambda x: 1 if x > 0 else (-1 if x < 0 else 0))
    
    # Check if trends match (same direction)
    df['trends_match'] = df['exceedance_direction'] == df['rainfall_direction']
    
    # Count matching and non-matching month-to-month transitions
    valid_transitions = df[df['exceedance_direction'] != 0].copy()
    
    if len(valid_transitions) > 0:
        matches = valid_transitions['trends_match'].sum()
        total = len(valid_transitions)
        match_rate = matches / total

        'Match_Rate': [match_rate],
        'Trends_Follow_Same_Pattern': [match_rate >= 0.5]
